g.text: Lab 2.3 — Name Resolution and Load Balancing
Two name paths to one workload: public through Azure DNS, private through a linked zone
1 · Public path — player to world server
2 · A private zone resolves nothing until it is linked
The records exist without a link — no VM can resolve them until the VNet is linked.
3 · The probe decides who gets traffic
Unhealthy threshold 2 · the VM stays in the backend pool, it simply stops receiving traffic
az CLI — the public record and the zone link
az network dns record-set a add-record -g platform-skycraft-swc-rg \
az network private-dns link vnet create -g platform-skycraft-swc-rg \
# -e true enables autoregistration: VMs publish their own A records
public A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV
